summary: Suzi conducts 300 pulls on the Option Summons selectable banner to secure Kurvida and finish building her Dauntless roster. Along the way, she pulls top-tier supports Maashtur and Irmoush, as well as Dauntless DPS Nastjenka. She builds a full Dauntless team of Selva, Maashtur, Guinavivre, Kurvida, and Nastjenka for Continental Challenge III boss Ergander. She strongly cautions players to never summon on 300-pity selectable banners unless they have 300 dice saved up to guarantee the milestone reward.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Considered the ultimate prize pull due to his massive team shields, stuns, buffs, and ultimate energy reduction.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.note: Essential component for establishing and completing high-end Dauntless team compositions.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.note: The premier original Dauntless damage dealer needed for boss challenges.

heroes.name: Tharivol
heroes.note: Functions well as an interim Dauntless damage dealer until Nastjenka is obtained.

heroes.name: Irmoush
heroes.note: Offers valuable silence, 50% Attack Penalty, Defense Up, and debuff immunity.

teams.note: A heavy Dauntless team composition utilizing Selva and Maashtur as dual supports against Ergander.

tips: Never pull on 300-summon selectable banners unless you have the full 300 summons saved to guarantee your hero.
The 300-summon selector is a separate milestone bonus chest and is not tied to pity or reset if you pull a legendary early.
Support heroes like Maashtur and Selva cannot easily be guaranteed on targeted DPS banners, making them high-priority pulls when available.
title: WOW!💥My Summoning Luck is BACK! 🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
